label: Rock in Rio 2026 — 05/09 (sáb) · Gramado
_note_filters: Gramado only (Juan's call 2026-09-01). entry_class is deliberately unfiltered: Rock in Rio does not check ticket type at the gate, so any class is usable and the cheapest one wins. Set extra.sector to null to watch all 6 sectors.
_note_rules: lowest_ever AND lowest_in_window are enabled (Juan, 2026-09-01). lowest_ever ratchets shut -- every record it sets raises its own bar, so it is quietest on the day you actually buy, which is the day it matters. On 2026-09-01 05/09 was trading at R$ 330,00 against a R$ 242,00 record: a 26.7% fall before it would say anything. lowest_in_window has an expiring baseline instead, so it still flags today's dip. 6h is chosen to span a buying session without carrying yesterday into it. below_threshold, drop_pct and price_changed stay configured but disabled; below_threshold's price_brl is the last re-baselined value and is stale by design.
_note_critical_price: critical_price is the anomaly floor, and it does TWO jobs from one number. (1) Any price under it alerts immediately -- on entering the band and on each new low inside it -- bypassing the 6h window entirely. (2) Nothing under it ever becomes a baseline for lowest_ever or lowest_in_window, so a mispricing cannot ratchet them shut. This is not hypothetical: on 2026-09-02T13:46Z a single R$ 66,00 Gramado || Inteira, present for one run and gone the next minute, took the lowest_ever record on 04/09 -- which has no expiry, so the rule was permanently dead on the night it was built for. X is set just under this night's observed floor (R$ 242,00), because a price that far below trading range is far more likely to be a listing error than a deal. The exclusion is applied on READ, so arming this heals a history that is already poisoned.
_note_buy: Read ONLY by the sibling tool knowledge/projects/ticket-autobuy. price-watcher itself never reads this key and never buys -- the boundary in its CLAUDE.md is unchanged. Authored 2026-09-02 for the FIRST REAL PURCHASE, on Juan's explicit instruction, to verify the one unmapped leg (_extract_pix). max_price_brl 310.00 is IN the money on purpose: 05/09 Gramado traded from ~302,50 that night, so this ceiling is chosen to fire, unlike 04/09's deliberately-out-of-the-money 220.00. entry_class stays unfiltered per the filters note, so the cheapest Gramado row wins. min_price_brl 200.00 mirrors critical_price: without it an armed buy takes ANY row under the ceiling, including a mispriced one -- and a R$ 66,00 Gramado||Inteira really did appear on this event on 2026-09-02. The floor refuses the glitch without touching the intended R$ 220,00 purchase. ⛔ DISARMED again after the 2026-09-02 verification runs. The ceiling is IN the money, so an armed target means any `buy` invocation spends ~R$275 -- arm it deliberately, immediately before a run, never leave it armed at rest.
